investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Although section 79(10) of the Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005 was repealed by the Serious Crime Act 2015, the transitional provisions of section 86 of the Serious Crime Act 2015 state that the repeal of this section does not apply in the case of a Financial Reporting Order (FRO) made before section 50(1)(a) comes into force. This means that a prosecution for this offence may be considered in regard to an FRO that was made before 3/5/2015, should the FRO still be within its duration.
(ii) Note that FROs were replaced with Serious Crime Prevention Orders (SCPOs).
